judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a partial specification, a `.lore/dod.md` file, and three failing acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`. It never modified `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, nor did it add `ajv` to `package.json`. Consequently, no input validation is actually implemented and the added tests will fail. Furthermore, almost all acceptance criteria—including documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`), orchestrator tests, and the remaining unit tests—are completely missing.
